description: No API key. CO2e emissions calculator on the official UK government (DESNZ) conversion factors 2023-2026: flights by IATA code (haul, cabin class, radiative forcing, +8% routing uplift), cars by size/segment and fuel incl. EV and hybrid, fuels by litre/kWh/tonne/gallon, UK electricity with grid losses, hotel nights in 40 countries, rail, bus, taxi, ferry, freight tonne-km (truck, van, ship, rail, air). Every answer carries the factor ID, year, Scope 1/2/3 split and CO2/CH4/N2O split. Up to 100 activities per call. Usable from AI agents via MCP. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/carbon-footprint-api.

activities.description: List of activities (max 100). Each object has a 'type': flight {from, to (IATA codes) or distanceKm, cabin: economy|premium_economy|business|first|average, passengers, roundTrip, radiativeForcing (default true)}; car {distance, unit: km|mil

includeTotal.description: For mode=calculate with 2+ activities: add one extra row with the total kgCO2e and the Scope 1/2/3 split of all activities.

limit.description: For mode=search: maximum number of factors returned.

mode.description: calculate = CO2e of your activities (one result row per activity); search = find official DESNZ factors by words (e.g. 'diesel litres', 'container ship', 'hotel japan') and get their factorId; categories = all factor categories with Scope,

query.description: For mode=search: words that must all appear in the factor path, e.g. 'diesel litres', 'hotel japan', 'refrigerant R410A', 'waste landfill'.

scope.description: For mode=search: only factors of this GHG Protocol scope. Empty = all scopes.

year.description: Which official DESNZ factor set to use. latest = the newest published set (2026). Use an older year to match last year's report.

name: carbon_footprint_api
